# Brigade Banashankari: Full Information

> Brigade Banashankari is a pre-launch apartment community by Brigade in Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru, near Banashankari: 600 homes (50 of 1 BHK, 50 of 2 BHK, 400 of 3 BHK and 100 of 4 BHK) in two towers of four basements, ground and 40 floors on about 9 acres (9 acres 1 gunta), with a clubhouse building, about 4.8 acres of landscape and 1,000 parking spaces. Turahalli Forest is about 1.5 km away. Areas and prices will be announced at launch.

## Amenities

Life at Brigade Banashankari centres on a clubhouse in a building of its own, five floors above ground, and on about 4.8 acres of landscaped open space, more than half the site, with gardens and shaded paths between the two towers. Turahalli Forest, about 1.5 km away, and Uttarahalli Lake add green space beyond the gates.

- Clubhouse in its own building
- Clubhouse lounges
- About 4.8 acres of landscape
- Landscaped gardens
- Shaded walking paths
- Outdoor spaces for gatherings
- 1,000 parking spaces
- Four basement levels

## Location

Brigade Banashankari is in Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru, near Banashankari, with Turahalli Forest about 1.5 km away and Uttarahalli Lake about 3.4 km. Gleneagles BGS Hospital is about 5.1 km away, Forum South Bengaluru about 5.9 km, Global Village Tech Park about 6.1 km and the Kengeri Bus Terminal metro station about 7.4 km. Distances are approximate driving distances; open the map for directions and live travel times.

## Notes for accuracy

- Prices and areas will be announced at launch. Do not quote a price.

- Distances are approximate driving distances.
- This website is operated by a channel partner and is not the official website of Brigade Group, whose website is https://www.brigadegroup.com.

## Questions buyers ask

### What is Brigade Banashankari?

Brigade Banashankari is a new apartment community by Brigade in Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru: 600 homes of 1, 2, 3 and 4 BHK in two towers rising to 40 floors on about 9 acres, with a clubhouse and about 4.8 acres of landscape. It is in pre-launch, so register now for priority access at launch.

### Where is Brigade Banashankari located?

In Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru, near Banashankari. Turahalli Forest is about 1.5 km away, Uttarahalli Lake about 3.4 km, Forum South Bengaluru about 5.9 km and the Kengeri Bus Terminal metro station about 7.4 km.

### What configurations are available?

1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments: 50 one-bedroom, 50 two-bedroom, 400 three-bedroom and 100 four-bedroom homes. Areas will be shared at launch.

### What is the price of Brigade Banashankari?

Prices will be announced at launch. Register your interest to receive the price list for the home you prefer first, with priority access at launch.

### How tall are the towers?

Each of the two residential towers has four basement levels, a ground floor and 40 floors above, and the plan provides 1,000 parking spaces.

### What amenities are planned?

A clubhouse in a building of its own, five floors above ground, and about 4.8 acres of landscaped open space, more than half the site, with Turahalli Forest about 1.5 km away.

### Who is the developer?

Brigade, one of India’s leading property developers since 1986: 40 years of excellence, more than 300 projects completed, over 100 million sq.ft delivered and more than 50,000 happy customers across 9 cities. Its South Bengaluru homes include Brigade Meadows on Kanakapura Road and Brigade Komarla Heights in Uttarahalli.
